title: A Dragon Without Pride
paragraphs: Happy New Year. I look forward to working with you again this year. The next day. I guess I have no choice—I’ll be using a portal to travel with Father to the meeting spot with Rival. We’ve got a bunch of diplomatic engagements lined up in Melromarc, after all. The main purpose is to hear about the issues regarding Trash and the results of the investigation. While I’m at it, I’d better ask him to arrange a visit to Cal Mira Island as well. With that in mind, as I was waiting in front of the mountain near Rival’s parents’ house—our meeting spot—…
“I’m home!”
Rival arrived, flying in the form of a dragon.
“Um…”

And for some reason, she’s brought along her Assistant, who’s got an incredibly intense glare in her eyes. The Assistant, still cradled in Rival’s arms, has been glaring at us the whole time. Father is pointing at Rival.
“Big Sister insisted on coming along and wouldn’t let go, so I brought her with me.”
“I found you! You little sister thieves! How dare you steal my little sister!”
Just as the Assistant said that, Rival quickly turned her back to hide the Assistant. She’s getting right to it, isn’t she?
“Big sis, that’s not what we agreed on. You’re not supposed to say things like that to Naofumi and the others.”
“But it’s the truth.”
“Hmm… That’s why I’ve explained it so many times. Gaelion chose to go with Naofumi and the others on her own.”
“But you said that name is Dad’s name!”
“I told you this, too. It’s a name given to Gaelion by a big sister from a different future.”
“But you’re still you.”
“Ugh, seriously… this is such a hassle… It’s not like Gaelion has started hating you or turned into a different dragon—he’s just out and about.”
“After making him grow this big, you’re still going to say that?”
It seems they’re still arguing about something. Heh heh heh, I think this would be a good opportunity to reveal Rival’s true identity to Father.
“Big Sis, Gaelion is a rising star. He’s an incredibly strong, invincible dragon. He’s a bit full of himself, but he only got to where he is thanks to Naofumi and the others.”
“What’s going to happen to our lives?”
“Well, I brought him some treats yesterday and gave him a territory, so Dad seemed satisfied.”
“Oh… that, huh.”
The Assistant seems genuinely off her rocker. She’s referring to her parent as “that.” I seem to recall that the Assistant from past loops actually respected her parent.
“Big sis, you should tone down your contempt for Dad a bit. He was really depressed when you hated him.”
“A dragon without pride who sacrificed his own daughter just to save his own skin.”
“Big sis, face the facts. Dad’s such a pathetic dragon that he can even call himself the Weakest Dragon Emperor. It’s too late now.”
“What’s that supposed to mean?”
The panda chimes in. With that, Rival turned around, forcing a smile.
“I’ll definitely get my little sister back!”
“Even though she looks so different now, you can still recognize Gaelion-chan as your little sister, huh?”
“Of course! You little sister-stealers! I’ve heard what you did to my little sister. You came from another world? So what?!”
“From the perspective of someone stuck in a loop, is this actually a welcome reaction?”
Father looks a bit puzzled. I’m not really sure. In most worlds, Fathers accept me without issue, so I haven’t really felt anything out of the ordinary.
“Big sis, shh…”
“Ah, wait a minute!”
Rival covers the Assistant’s mouth with her hand before explaining to Fathers.
“She went home to win a turf war and improve her parents’ lives. Separately from that, Big Sister had fallen ill.”
“Hmm, I can kind of tell just by looking at her. It seems she really isn’t okay after all.”

“It seems she took my brother and sisters with her to hunt monsters and train in search of strength. Apparently, she was trying her best to get Gaelion back. She must have been pretty energetic, because her territory had gotten quite large.”

This loop’s Assistant seems quite aggressive, doesn’t she? To think she was acting like some sort of monster tamer while leading her siblings around… Come to think of it, she was chosen as one of the Vassal Weapons in the first world, wasn’t she? Maybe she really did have a knack for it.
“And… she seems to be convinced that Dad handed over Gaelion just to save his own life, so she’d lost her dignity and was feeling down.”
“Your parents have been pathetic for a while now.”
“I won’t deny it.”
“No, let’s just deny that part.”
After all, they’re parent dragons. It’s too late to be pathetic now. If anything, Rival is the most troublesome of the lot.

“So, just as I was about to leave—thinking it was time to go—Big Sister refused to budge, insisting she’d absolutely come with me, so I ended up having to look after her for a while. Even Dad couldn’t refuse, given Gaelion’s strength.”
“Well… if that’s what it takes to satisfy her, isn’t that fine? Though… is it really okay to take her to Shieldfreeden…?”
“My big sis has a certain wild instinct, so she’s sensitive. I think she’ll be fine once I do a Class Up on her.”
That’s a pretty casual way of putting it.
“To begin with, my big sis…”
Rival spreads his arms wide and speaks to the Assistant with a serious expression, as if trying to reason with him.
“No matter how hard you try, Big Sis, you’re not a dragon… Dad was planning to send you back to the human world eventually. That won’t change even with Gaelion. Are you… aware of that?”
The Assistant remains silent, her brows furrowed conspicuously. It feels like the kind of thing you know deep down, but it’s still unpleasant when it’s thrown in your face.

“No matter how things turn out, if Dad were to be killed in some incident, Big Sister’s life would be over. To prevent that, Big Sister was scheduled to leave the nest soon. Gaelion was entrusted to her as a younger sister to help with that.”
Having said that, Rival gazes at Father with a distant, somewhat lonely look in her eyes. Hahaha, that look won’t work on me. It’s useless trying to elicit my sympathy.
“…Originally, Gaelion was supposed to die without fulfilling that role, and my older sister…”
After a moment, Rival shook her head slightly and said to her Assistant:

“My older sister is going to experience the human world alongside Gaelion. After all, the world is currently facing an unprecedented crisis, and that’s why Gaelion is working hard alongside everyone else.”
“A newborn little sister’s job is to grow up playing!”
“She’s already had plenty of fun and grown up by now! From now on, I’m going to show Big Sister some difficult and fun toys… I’m going to show her the world!”
Does that mean she’s going to turn the world into a toy!? She’s a real piece of work.
“Gaelion, that sounds like it’d be really bad for that kid’s education. Are you sure it’s okay?”
“I kind of get the feeling something’s off here.”
“No doubt about it.”
“Please don’t nitpick my words. Anyway, big sis, you’re going to keep your promise. Otherwise, I’m leaving you behind right here.”
Rival seized the moment to intimidate the Assistant. The Assistant then looked over at us with a reluctant expression and said:
“My name is Wyndia… May I… stay with you for a while?”
Father looked at Rival, then shifted his gaze to the Assistant and nodded.
“Yeah, sure. Gaelion, make sure to protect her well.”
“It’s a big sister’s job to protect her little sister!”
“Big sis, you know Gaelion is stronger right now. In the wild, strength determines the hierarchy. Whether you’re the older or younger sister, that’s an undeniable fact.”
Hmm… I see. Her pride as an older sister is getting the better of her, I suppose. Honestly, the Assistant right now would be knocked out by a single flick from Rival.

“Well then… since you probably don’t want to face us, make sure you don’t stray from Gaelion-chan, okay? And you know, I didn’t exactly ‘steal’ Gaelion-chan—I’m just borrowing her strength. So, whenever Gaelion-chan wants to go home, I’ll send her right back.”
“That would make me a little lonely, though—”

Rival is seizing this chance to make his move, but Father isn’t falling for your temptations anymore! He’s got an elephant and a panda, after all. Father is a man of integrity. The assistant looked back and forth between Father and Rival, then nodded.
“I understand… I look forward to working with you from now on.”
It seems the assistant has accepted Father’s instructions, as he’s sticking close to Rival and tagging along with us. And so, we headed to the castle in Melromarc.
“Thank you very much for joining us at this meeting in Melromarc.”
The queen opened the meeting with a greeting. Representing Siltvelt were Father and the elders of the Shusaku and Genmu clans. Representing Shieldfreeden was Rival.

It seems this meeting is for a progress report on that Trash who escaped and to discuss matters related to Éclair’s family. Officially, it’s a discussion aimed at building friendly relations, and it seems they need the pretext that Shieldfreeden is cooperating.

There are various other matters as well, so I absolutely must have a talk with the Queen. Whenever they have a spare moment, Sakura-chan and Filolial-sama go visit their Finacées. I’d like to go hang out with Filolial-sama, too.

“Regarding this report… well, as for the impostor claiming to be the Wise King of Wisdom who escaped from our castle… we still haven’t been able to locate him. We can only lament our own shortcomings.”
“No… please don’t worry about it…”

After all, rather than just being good at hiding, there are some shady characters involved. Still, I wonder where Trash is hiding. By the way, my assistant can’t quite wrap his head around the situation and is looking around nervously while sitting on Rival’s lap.
“Still… it’s actually pretty impressive that we still can’t find him…”
“Even though people from our country are cooperating in the search…”

I hear that a tracking team from Siltvelt is also taking various actions. And yet, he still can’t be found… Could he have just died alone somewhere? If he were to show up as a ghost, I’d take it as nothing but a joke. HAHAHA.
“In any case, please do not let your guard down.”

“Yeah. Also, as a countermeasure against the one impersonating the Wise King, I’ve been told that the subordinates of Larsazusa—my guardian knight—will lend a hand. Please discuss this later when I’m not around.”

I heard that if the tiger siblings were to meet Father, it would cause problems within Siltvelt. Thanks to the medical care, the tiger girl has made a full recovery, and she’s been going out here and there, carried on the tiger boy’s back. She says she can walk, but it seems she hasn’t tried it yet. Well, I think the Queen will understand the situation just by seeing the tiger girl.
“Understood. By the way, is Knight Éclair able to be of assistance to the Heroes?”
“Yes, absolutely… I believe it is thanks to her that Melromarc and Siltvelt have been able to maintain friendly relations despite these events.”
It seems Father is praising Éclair with the highest possible praise.
“Therefore, I would very much like you to prioritize the reconstruction of Knight Eclair’s domain.”

“As requested by Siltvelt, we are currently working at a rapid pace to rebuild the Seaetto domain. We are continuing various projects, starting with the protection of those who were targeted in the slave raids.”
“That’s the most important thing.”

It seems the people from Big Sister’s village are also being protected and are in the process of rebuilding. It’s a shame we can’t carry out that sort of work in this loop. Couldn’t you convince him by pointing to Éclair’s military exploits and saying Father is urging him to help?

Well… I understand why it’s better not to tell Big Sister—as Rival mentioned. After all, she was so shaken when she found out Big Sister had passed away. Back then, she managed to pull through thanks to Father’s passion, but if she were to learn the truth upon meeting him for the first time and fall ill again, even Father wouldn’t be able to be that firm.
It’s frustrating, isn’t it…? Since lies won’t work on Big Sister’s older sister, it’s impossible to keep deceiving her. Having this knowledge of the loop is incredibly inconvenient.

“Oh, right. Some good news from within our kingdom of Melromarc: I’ve heard that Sakura-sama of Filolial—whom my daughter Melty and the Heroes are taking care of—is gaining popularity thanks to the publicity efforts at taverns across the land, including the nobles’ soirées.”

The Queen reports this to me with a smile. Oh… Is my Finacée spreading Sakura-chan’s popularity throughout Melromarc? It’s truly fitting of a Finacée that things have turned out this way even though I didn’t say anything in particular. It’s frustrating, but I have no choice but to acknowledge her character and abilities.
